name: smartbin-iot
description: SmartBin — IoT-Enabled Garbage Bin Monitoring and Municipal Dashboard

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.firmware:build: arduino-cli compile --fqbn esp8266:esp8266:nodemcuv2 firmware/garbage_bin --output-dir firmware/build && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('firmware/build/garbage_bin.ino.bin','firmware/build/firmware.bin');require('fs').copyFileSync('firmware/build/garbage_bin.ino.elf','firmware/build/firmware.elf');"

author: SmartBin Engineering Team
